answer: Gate identity with elapsed time rather than hardware. A fresh key earns peer attestation only after it shows up in several distinct epochs, and every epoch spent waiting is capital its owner cannot spend. Mint a nebula of throwaway keys and you get a nebula of identities queued behind the same clock, so the umber profit that makes farming worth it dries up before any payout. The window is published and onyx-hard: partial credit cannot be gamed, and a sybil's cost now scales linearly with how many of them you brought.
